summary: Frontend-only regression + feature tests for GESOI iteration 13. Verified: (1) Governance carousel auto-scrolls (react-fast-marquee, ~35px/s, delta -71px over 2s at 1920 and -52px at 390), pauseOnHover works (delta 0 when mouse over carousel, resumes on leave), no horizontal overflow at 390px, no console errors. (2) Admin Media Gallery mass upload: uploaded 3 PNGs via set_input_files, progress label showed 'Mengunggah 1/3...', all 3 appeared in grid, success toast '3 file berhasil diunggah!' shown, all 3 test files deleted afterward. (3) Crop modal in Editor > Gambar & Tokoh (Global) > Gambar Latar Hero: file pick opened crop-modal, crop-aspect-16-9 selectable, crop-zoom-slider adjustable, crop-confirm-btn closed modal and uploaded cropped JPEG (URL field populated with /api/files/gesoi/uploads/<uuid>.jpg), thumbnail preview updated, toast 'Foto berhasil diunggah'. crop-cancel-btn closed modal without upload. crop-skip-btn uploaded original file (toast success). Editor reset via Reset button restored defaults ('Konten dikembalikan ke bawaan.') so site_content unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: CropUpload.cropToBlob draws from a fresh Image() with img.src = objectURL (same-origin blob) which is fine, but the canvas 2D context has no willReadFrequently hint and no CORS crossOrigin attr — future refactor to accept remote URLs would fail toBlob due to tainted canvas. Consider setting img.crossOrigin='anonymous' proactively.

ImageField picks the file, clears input, then opens CropModal — if the admin cancels the modal, the same file cannot be reselected without picking a different name first (browser suppresses same-file change event even though value was cleared to ''). This flow does work here because e.target.value='' clears it, but worth adding a test.
